CREATE TABLE [dbo].[CutomerDetails](
	[custId] [smallint] ,
	[CustName] [varchar](200) ,
	[CustCity] [varchar](200) ,
	[ProdPurchaseDate] [date] ,
	[ProdQty] [tinyint] ,
	[ProdPrice] [decimal](6, 2) 
) 
WITH
( DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN);
